reports.title: New black bass regulations on Bussey Brake reinstated
reports.text:
The Louisiana Wildlife and Fisheries Commission reinstated the new 18-inch length limit and associated details indicated below. These new rules were originally passed in August 2025 but were inadvertently reversed in the June 2026 hunting regulations for Wildlife Management Areas.
Summary of Bussey Brake Black Bass Regulations
The maximum length limit for black bass is 18 inches
One bass over 22 inches may be temporarily retained in an aerated livewell immediately prior to weighing on a personal scale or LDWF-provided certified scale
The bass over 22 inches must be immediately released into Bussey Brake Reservoir following weighing
All anglers in the boat (if caught from boat) must cease…
